summary: Official municipal evidence qualifies Tesorería Municipal/Dirección de Catastro of San Martín Texmelucan as the local cadastral custodian and documents municipal cartography/geobase and parcel-polygon workflows. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified from the public routes inspected, so no sample GeoJSON is retained.
custodian: Tesorería Municipal / Dirección de Catastro, San Martín Texmelucan. Puebla SEI/Geoportal is a general state geographic-information source, not the local cadastral custodian.
requests: English and Spanish first-party discovery queries, municipal GETs, official PDF/map-catalog opens, and state Geoportal inspection are recorded in the city record with outcomes. One local curl to the Geoportal failed to connect; no login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe-field request, or TLS exception was used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: The WUP point [19.2781167722746, -98.4307403996516] and population 190749 persons are preserved.
Municipal procedures establish cadastral administration and polygon editing but do not prove public parcel-vector access.
The state Geoportal and map catalog were treated as general geographic sources unless a parcel schema and bounded response could be shown; neither was qualified.
No exact-point hit/miss, map extent miss, timeout, or connection failure was treated as citywide absence.
No unsafe land-record fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: A supported authenticated or dynamically loaded state/municipal client may expose additional layers, but that was outside the allowed anonymous research scope.
No current native parcel identifier, geometry schema, CRS, bounded parcel response, or citywide coverage was qualified.
